answers.core: Seems like something that's an engine UI level improvement.
answers.workaround:
1) User right clicks on a folder containing all the textures for a prop. 
2) An additional context menu appears among the usual set.
3) A New .tres material is created and placed into the same folder
4) Godot goes through a list of defined texture suffix or prefix definitions and scans that folder to see if any texture files match.
5) If a rule says that albedo is marked with a suffix of _albedo, and a texture is found (telephone_pole_albed.jpeg), it is applied to the albedo texture input map in the spatial material created before.
6) Repeat for other maps.

title: Create Spatial Material by right clicking on a folder containing textures and clicking on a context menu.
